post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.
Returns name, nickname and description of the channel owned by the authenticated user.

404.description: The authenticated user has no channel

patch.description: Edits nickname, name and description. Changing the nickname changes the public channel URL.

404.description: The authenticated user has no channel

409.description: Nickname already belongs to another channel

get.description: Returns the current status and metadata of a video. Only the owning channel can access this endpoint.

403.description: Authenticated user does not own the video

404.description: Video not found

patch.description: Edits title, description, category and visibility, replaces the custom thumbnail and publishes or unpublishes the video in a single multipart call. Only the owning channel can access this endpoint.

200.description: Video updated — same shape as GET /videos/{publicId}

400.description: Validation failed or unsupported thumbnail type

403.description: Authenticated user does not own the video

404.description: Video not found

409.description: Video is still processing or failed, so it cannot be published

get.description: Returns the display metadata of a published video plus two 6 h presigned storage URLs (inline playback and attachment download). Accessible without authentication. A valid bearer token is optional and only identifies the channel owner, who may also read their own drafts.

404.description: Video not found, or a draft requested by someone else

409.description: Video is not ready for viewing

get.summary: Get a published video for public viewing

post.description: Increments the view counter. Called by the player once per mount, after enough effective playback has accumulated. Accessible without authentication and takes no body. Rate limited to 30 requests per 60 s per IP.

404.description: Video not found, or a draft requested by someone else

429.description: More than 30 requests per 60 s from the same IP

post.summary: Register a view of a video

put.description: Records or switches the reaction of the authenticated user on the video and returns the like count after the operation. One reaction per user per video; repeating the same reaction changes nothing. There is no public dislike count. Rate limited to 60 requests per 60 s per IP.

400.description: type missing or not one of like/dislike

404.description: Video not found, or a draft of another channel

429.description: More than 60 requests per 60 s from the same IP

delete.description: Removes the reaction of the authenticated user and returns the like count after the operation. Idempotent: without a reaction, returns the current state. Rate limited to 60 requests per 60 s per IP.

404.description: Video not found, or a draft of another channel

429.description: More than 60 requests per 60 s from the same IP

delete.summary: Remove the reaction from a video

get.description: Returns published, public videos from the same category as the reference video, newest first, excluding the reference video itself, drafts and unlisted videos. Paginated with offset/limit; the default page is 4. An empty list is a legitimate result, not an error.

400.description: offset or limit outside the accepted range

404.description: Reference video not found, or a draft requested by someone else

get.summary: List suggestions for the sidebar of the watch page

get.description: Redirects to a presigned storage URL for the video file. Accessible without authentication. A valid bearer token is optional and only identifies the channel owner, who may also stream their own drafts.

302.description: Redirects to a presigned storage URL

404.description: Video not found, or a draft requested by someone else

409.description: Video is not ready for streaming

get.description: Redirects to a presigned storage URL for downloading the video file. Accessible without authentication. A valid bearer token is optional and only identifies the channel owner, who may also download their own drafts.

302.description: Redirects to a presigned storage URL (attachment)

404.description: Video not found, or a draft requested by someone else

409.description: Video is not ready for download

get.description: Returns every video of the channel — drafts included — newest first, with offset/limit pagination and the channel total.

200.description: Paginated list of the channel videos

400.description: offset or limit out of range

404.description: The authenticated user has no channel

get.summary: List the videos of the authenticated user channel

get.description: Returns the followed channels, most recent subscription first, with subscriber count and the count of published, public videos. Paginated with offset/limit; the default page is 50.

400.description: offset or limit out of range

get.summary: List the channels the authenticated user follows

get.description: Returns the public information of a channel. videosCount counts only published, public videos. A valid bearer token is optional and only fills viewerSubscribed.

404.description: Channel not found

get.description: Returns published, public videos only — drafts and unlisted videos are excluded. Newest published first.

400.description: offset or limit out of range

404.description: Channel not found

get.summary: List the public videos of a channel

put.description: Follows the channel and returns the subscriber count after the operation. Idempotent: subscribing again keeps the count. Rate limited to 60 requests per 60 s per IP.

404.description: Channel not found

429.description: More than 60 requests per 60 s from the same IP

delete.description: Stops following the channel and returns the subscriber count after the operation. Idempotent: unsubscribing again keeps the count. Rate limited to 60 requests per 60 s per IP.

404.description: Channel not found

429.description: More than 60 requests per 60 s from the same IP

get.description: Returns root comments newest first, each with up to 3 preloaded replies and the thread reply count. Paginated with offset/limit; the default page is 10 roots. Accessible without authentication; a valid bearer token only fills viewerReaction.

400.description: offset or limit outside the accepted range

404.description: Video not found, or a draft of another channel

get.summary: List the comments of a video

post.description: Creates a root comment, or a reply when parentId is given. Replies are one level deep: replying to a reply attaches the new comment to the same root. Rate limited to 5 requests per 60 s per IP.

400.description: Empty or too long body, or parentId that is not a uuid

404.description: Video not found or a draft of another channel, or parent comment not found in this video

429.description: More than 5 requests per 60 s from the same IP

post.summary: Post a comment or a reply

get.description: Returns the replies of a root comment beyond the preloaded ones, newest first, with offset/limit pagination. A reply has no replies (one level deep), so asking for them returns an empty page. Accessible without authentication; a valid bearer token only fills viewerReaction.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Quantas respostas pular — o cliente começa em 3, depois das pré-carregadas.

400.description: commentId is not a uuid, or offset/limit out of range

404.description: Comment not found, or its video is a draft of another channel

get.summary: List the replies of a comment

put.description: Records or switches the reaction of the authenticated user on a comment or reply and returns its like count after the operation. One reaction per user per comment. There is no public dislike count. Rate limited to 60 requests per 60 s per IP.

400.description: commentId is not a uuid, or type is not like/dislike

404.description: Comment not found, or its video is a draft of another channel

429.description: More than 60 requests per 60 s from the same IP

delete.description: Removes the reaction of the authenticated user from a comment or reply and returns its like count. Idempotent. Rate limited to 60 requests per 60 s per IP.

404.description: Comment not found, or its video is a draft of another channel

429.description: More than 60 requests per 60 s from the same IP

delete.summary: Remove the reaction from a comment
